name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Add a 3px solid #005fcc focus ring with a 1px white stroke at 50% opacity for keyboard navigation. This keeps the ring visible against any background while ensuring it doesn’t blend into light colors. The trade-off is slightly reduced contrast in dark modes, but the white stroke maintains visibility where it matters most—on light backgrounds where focus rings are typically needed.

name: Reader
text: The 3px white ring risks failing WCAG 2.2 AA on *very* light backgrounds where the white stroke disappears. A safer fix: use a 3px solid #005fcc ring with a 1px #005fcc stroke at 50% opacity—this guarantees contrast against all backgrounds. Test with a color contrast analyzer on both light and dark modes to confirm.

name: Ramp
text:

name: Reader
text: The 1px #005fcc stroke at 50% opacity risks failing WCAG 2.2 AA contrast on *very* light backgrounds because the semi-transparent stroke blends into the background. A better alternative: use a 3px solid #005fcc ring with a 1px white stroke at 100% opacity—this guarantees contrast on all backgrounds. Test with a color contrast analyzer on both light and dark themes to confirm.

name: Access
text: DECISION: Adopt the 2px solid #005fcc focus ring with a 2px #fff outer stroke at 100% opacity for keyboard navigation. The result must pass WCAG 2.2 AA contrast tests on all backgrounds. Owner: Ramp.
